purpose: Offline comparison candidates for the SAME barrel geometry, camera and illumination; not certified final game assets

mapping.notes: Shared eight plank arrangement and knot positions; no mesh changes. Imagegen edit preserves broad mapping. These are comparison candidates; exact cyclic border continuity has not been production validated.

fixed_scene.illumination: unchanged source, exposure, ambient, render settings
fixed_scene.texture_mapping: keep original carrier UV + mapping nodes

styles.label: 原神方向
styles.stroke_structure: Clean long tapered ribbons; broad simplified curving knots; sparse clean chips; little micro-noise

shading.notes: Crisper graphic value group, do not bake light into albedo

styles.label: 明日方舟：终末地方向
styles.stroke_structure: Fine irregular fibers and weathering, low-contrast rubbed natural grain, restrained wear, de-emphasized decorative outlines

shading.notes: Continuous broad physical shading, modest realistic metal response, avoid overly polished iron

styles.label: 宫崎骏／吉卜力方向
styles.stroke_structure: Layered watercolor/gouache washes with soft mottling, paper-pigment edges, delicate washed umber knot contours
styles.frequency: broad mottled washes plus soft fiber marks

shading.notes: Soft traditional animation-background value grouping; weak, broad response

styles.label: BK（暂按已批准工作台方向）
styles.stroke_structure: Angular broad chisel facets, polygonal knots, squared scars, low-detail hand-carved graphic blocks
styles.frequency: large angular marks, intentionally sparse micro-detail

shading.notes: Definite chunky value planes; exact BK source unidentified, do not label as exact game match

styles.label: 手绘油画方向
styles.stroke_structure: Broken-color ochre/sienna/violet/olive strokes, broad bristle drag, thick impasto-like marks encoded in color, gestural wood rhythm
styles.frequency: mid-frequency expressive brush clusters and visible drybrush texture

shading.notes: Continuous soft shading so the painted brushwork provides value complexity; no normal-map emboss or glints

styles.label: Bloomwalker方向
styles.stroke_structure: Opaque creamy gouache groups, rounded teardrop grain, warm soft oval knots, soft crescent wear, restrained pastel moss undertone
styles.frequency: low and middle frequency rounded motifs, quieter than oil

shading.notes: Soft storybook 3D value grouping, rounded coherent local forms; no glow or lighting edits

rendering_guidance.optional_cel_implementation: Use Geometry Normal dot the existing fixed scene's key-light direction, remap to 0..1, threshold according to style, and blend factors into diffuse color at stated strength. Keep light direction, intensity and shadow settings fixed. Use diffuse BSDF/Principled as the physical carrier. Shader bands are proposed original art treatment, not claimed exact source-game shaders.
rendering_guidance.material_uv: Do not center-crop textures or substitute camera textures; load each full square sRGB image in Shared_Source_Albedo. Keep source UV/mapping identical.
rendering_guidance.normal_maps: none; all brush variation remains original generated local-color albedo
rendering_guidance.acceptance: comparison review only; exact tiling, mobile, Unity and native routing not accepted

source_constraints.copyright: Original AI generated texture candidates. Reference game/movie screenshots remain owned by their respective rights holders; not copied into deliverable textures. No logo, character or raw game texture extracted.
source_constraints.license: No separate source-game asset license acquired. Style reference is not an authorization to redistribute reference images or trademarked art.
source_constraints.bk: Exact named BK source absent; previous approved workbench is comparison context only.
